newsitem.title: USA: Collins gets Boeing, Airbus certifications.
newsitem.headline: Collins gets Boeing, Airbus certifications.

text.p: Collins Commercial Avionics, a unit of Rockwell International Corp, said Friday it received certification from both Boeing Co and Airbus Industrie for its landing aids.

Airbus will replace old equipment with the Collins Global Navigation Landing Unit in as many as 100 aircrafts, Collins said, and its Multi-Mode Receiver (MMR) has been selected for use in future aircraft.
Boeing certified the MMR for its Maersk 737-700 plane, and additional certifications are in the works, Collins said. Maersk is a Danish airline.

In addition, Collins said it will enhance its traffic collision avoidance system, more than doubling its surveillance range to 100 nautical miles. The changes are expected to be in place by late 1997.
